text: A doc comment or shipped document states a fact about the code that no test computes, and it is wrong. Article IX reaches a fact held in two places; a single unguarded claim falls outside it, which is why this recurs. Instances in one session: a rule count of five where the tree had eight, four names where the tool resolves a different set, 612 declaration names that do not reproduce, one performance magnitude written three ways across a comment and two commit bodies, a limit said to cut three ways where two reviewers each found a further face, and a release commit asserting that a version moves no verdict where its own test pins one that moves. Every one was found by a reviewer rather than by the suite. The answer applied here was to compute the claim in a test per face, which then fails when the claim stops holding.
source: six instances across this session, 2026-09-04; five found by review, one by re-measuring
